title: Release reset at the right moment
story: A chip stays in reset until its reset pin rises past 2.5 V. The pin is charged from the 5 V supply through a resistor into a 100 nF capacitor. The chip's oscillator needs 0.6 ms to start, and the system must be running before 0.8 ms. Make the pin cross 2.5 V between 0.6 ms and 0.8 ms after power-up.

goals.label: reset pin crosses 2.5 V between 0.6 ms and 0.8 ms

hints: 2.5 V is half of the supply. Half-way takes 0.693 x R x C.
0.6 ms to 0.8 ms of crossing time means tau between about 0.87 ms and 1.15 ms.
R = tau / C, with C = 100 nF.
